segments.text: Ayame is a digital artist and the former partner of Kamui. On the exterior, she has a calm and collected personality, although she claims to have intense bottled-up emotions.

She's naturally drawn to Kamui due to being one of the 1,440 girls chosen for the Ayame Maspro portion of the Shelter Kids Policy. She was raised in the Shelters, and like the other girls, had her memory of the experience wiped afterwards.
Edited from the Wiki
The bartender is a kind and thoughtful man. He listens to Tokio's problems, and often gives sage advice, whether Tokio accepts it or not.
Description from the Wiki
Affiliation: 24 Wards Heinous Crimes Unit 1
Role: Special Agent
Weapon: SIG Pro
An eccentric man who usually works investigations alone.
Originally from the Public Security Department, he has connections fall over the place.
He's also close with neighboring jurisdictions, and supports investigations with his own info.
His trademarks are his slicked-back hair and pressed shirts.
From the in-game profile
Mikoshiba Kenta is a competent detective who transferred from the Central Police Department to the Heinous Crimes Unit with Natsume Sakura.
Nakama is an avid user of the internet, and like Furuya she believes it has the power to connect people.
She believes that Furuya is special, and joins him with the goal to surpass Kamui.
Edited from the Wiki

The original incarnation of Uehara Kamui who was born on Lospass Island. At the age of two, his left eye was replaced with a silver eye in accordance with ancient Sundance Tribe rituals. Eventually, when he was in Kanto, he was killed in an event known as the Silver Case.

In an attempt to replicate Format Kamui's personality as well as his silver eye, the Shelter Kids Policy was put into place. Because those who acquire a silver eye can have their personalities transmitted into others who are primed to receive them, Ward 24 was inadvertently turned into a breeding ground for the concept known as Uehara Kamui.
A counterpart to Kamui was also developed in the form of Shimohira Ayame, which consists of the same Kamui personality being transmitted to a female host.
Edited from the Wiki

Daigo is a resolute officer, dedicated to eliminating crime by any means necessary. He is also very devoted to his daughter Sakura, and worked tirelessly to try and learn the truth behind her kidnapping. He has intimate knowledge of the true nature of crime, and believes that it must be eradicated completely to avoid transmission. He is very cautious and always warns others to follow orders exactly.
From the Wiki
A cool and collected member of the Special Forces Unit Republic, who's able to keep his emotions in check despite sometimes feeling scared.
A former syndicate member, he had been drained of all hope and was willing to throw his life away.
He is grateful to Natsume Daigo for recruiting him and is willing to put his life in his hands.
Edited from the Wiki
Inomata is a hot-headed and rash member of the special forces.
He often disobeys or questions orders, and places himself in danger.
He dislikes Akira, considering him "frigid" due to his suppressed emotions.
After the mission at Cauliflower, he began to doubt his abilities. He is close to Sakamoto Kenichi, and put himself in danger to avenge him.
Description from the Wiki
Furuya is a timid and anti-social young man, with little social life outside of the internet. He has a god complex, and secretly wishes to change the world through the power of the Internet.

While he idolizes Kamui, this created a resentment towards him and Furuya wished to surpass him in scale. After the launch of Method Tank, Furuya changed his demeanor and appearance significantly, speaking in cryptic terms and fully embracing his status as a revolutionary.
Edited from Wiki
Hikaru is an average Japanese boy. He experiences bullying at school, which his friend Koichi tries to protect him from.
He has a weaker personality than Koichi and often needs someone to stand up for him. Koichi says that he "laughs like a frog".

As a ghost, Hikaru is concerned with helping Koichi, and feels apologetic for making him feel guilty. On one occasion, he appears as a frightening mangled spirit, angrily declaring he won't let anyone bully Koichi.
Description from the Wiki
Koichi is an average Japanese boy. He experiences bullying at school and has negative feelings about many of his classmates.
After his friend's death, he refused to accept it and pretended that he was simply missing.
Description from the Wiki
A Kamui fanatic who is interviewed by Tokio.

Later revealed to be the administrator of the Shelter Kids Policy, overseeing the development of the Kamui and Ayame stock. After this he became an intense believer in Ayame, and began working for the syndicates of Ward 24 while keeping track of how the children grew.
He realized the plan of Nezu to release Kamui into Ward 24, and decided to back Ayame against him.
Edited from the Wiki

Sakaguchi is a crime investigation advisor for the Central Police Department. He's an old-school detective who is not fond of the Heinous Crimes Unit. He takes the lead on the 'Yukimura Zaibatsu' case.
After the destruction of Snow Tower, Central's reputation was ruined. Sakaguchi took full responsibility to save his subordinates' jobs and went to another unknown assignment 'out in the sticks.'
Munakata Ryu is Kusabi Tetsugorou's friend whom he occasionally meets with at the Harakiri Batting Center.
The protagonist of the Transmitter storyline. A soldier in the special task force Republic. His name is chosen by the player at the beginning.
The protagonist of the Placebo storylines. A freelance journalist who has been tasked with investigating the serial killer Uehara Kamui.
Affiliation: 24 Wards Heinous Crimes Unit 2
Role: Special Agent
Weapon: Colt Officer's ACP
Out of loyalty to veteran detective Kotobuki, he joined the Heinous Crimes Unit upon its establishment.
He sometimes acts as Sumio's stopper, and sometimes troubles the younger agents with his explosive behavior.
More afraid of being hated by his daughter than anything else in the world. Kusabi is seriously considering quitting smoking.
Currently, his biggest source of worry is his eldest daughter Toriko's overseas studies.
From the in-game profile
The omnipresent Uehara Kamui, born from the Shelter Kids Policy and the silver eye implanted into the original, Format Kamui when he was a child. His existence transcends life and death.
An infamous serial killer responsible for the Silver Case incident many years ago. Over the years, he has become a controversial cultural entity in the Wards due to murdering corrupt politicians.
He is not the original Kamui, but a decoy known as Kamui Fujiwara placed in prison following the death of the original Kamui
Affiliation: 24 Wards Heinous Crimes Unit 2
Role: Special Agent
Weapon: SIG Sauer P229
The backbone of the 24 Wards HC Unit, he works investigations together with Kusabi.
Not one to conform to nor conflict with the police force he knows his place and puts all of his focus on crime.
From the in-game profile

cast.characterName: シロヤブ モクタロウ
cast.originalCharacterName: シロヤブ モクタロウ

segments.text: A rookie detective in the HCU.
His real name is Shimohira Mokutarou and he is the son of Uehara Kamui.
A mysterious acquaintance of Tokio's, known for their digital skills.
A psychotic stalker who terrorizes Tokio.
His true idenitity is Kaiji Enzawa, the chief supervisor for the Shelter Kids experiments.

One of the characters of the Transmitter storyline. An officer of the Central Police Department, Dakichi Sakaguchi's aide. He is a rather direct man who values subordination and competence, often willing to go to great lengths to achieve results.
Ryo Kazan is one of the protagonists of Moonlight Syndrome. He also appears in Twilight Syndrome: Investigation and The Silver Case.
From KamuiNet:Save the Past
Affiliation: 24 Wards Heinous Crimes Unit 1
Role: Special Agent
Weapon: SIG Sauer P232
Assigned to the HC Unit as Morikawa's partner.
A beautiful female detective who originally worked in the crime lab. Her father is 24 Wards Mayor Kaoru Hachisuka.
Extremely serious and hardworking when it comes to her duties she is quite proud and tends to stick out within the department.
Not very well-liked by Kusabi.
From the in-game profile
Affiliation: 24 Wards Heinous Crimes Unit 1
Role: Special Agent
Weapon: Beretta M92F
Joined the HC Unit together with Kusabi from the time it was established.
One of the oldest members, having learned the basics of investigation from Kotobuki.
Known for his excellent investigation work, he is a support specialist.
Cleverly using the truth to his advantage, his investigative style is veteran-level.
Strongly trusted by Kotobuki, he is usually tasked with writing up "Silver Case" reports.
From the in-game profile
The hacker who worked with Uminosuke Hachisuka to create the Shelter Kids poilcy.

A reporter with a forward, smart and kind personality. Working for a local newspaper, she's experienced in the field of investigation. She has a deep story with Tokio. Enough to answer his call for help and assist him.
Daughter of Daigo Natsume, a member of the Republic Special Forces Unit and ex-collegue of your character, after an incident involving her dad, Sakura is determined to join the HCU to catch Kamui.
Affiliation: 24 Wards Heinous Crimes Prevention Unit
Role: Chief Director
Deeply insightful and very conscientious and sympathetic. Consequently, his popularity is amazing. Kotobuki doesn't directly go out into the field, but he provides crucial support from the sidelines.
Cases are never solved by chasing them, from Kotobuki's point of view. "You have to wait patiently." He is a man who knows how to manage people.
From the in-game profile
